Scenario fixture: rgaa-button-name-present

Each target has a stable id of the form bnp_case_NN. RGAA 7.1.1 covers the buttons outside any form, which work only through script; the buttons in a form are 11.9.1's.

A. Button outside a form with no name (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: empty button
02 — FAIL: icon button whose image has an empty alt
03 — FAIL: role="button" with no name

B. Image button with no alternative (CANTTELL)

04 — CANTTELL: image button named only by the browser

C. Named buttons (PASS)

05 — PASS: text content
06 — PASS: aria-label

D. Out of scope (NOT APPLICABLE)

07 — NOT APPLICABLE: empty button in a form (11.9.1)
08 — NOT APPLICABLE: empty button joined to a form by its form attribute
09 — NOT APPLICABLE: button hidden from assistive technologies
